tools.label: Typographic arrows:
n.dropwrong1: And what exactly is that supposed to do?
n.typo_done: Yes, yes, you already found that one. Stop rubbing it in.
h.none: No ideas right now. Odd: I usually have too many.
card.ch4.label: Chapter 4
card.ch4.title: The Forbidden Chapter
end.ch4.title: End of Chapter 4
end.ch4.body:
The Narrator is a blue illustration and, for the first time, someone is reading him.
In Chapter 5 the Proofreader won't be so kind.
page.p13.title: Chapter 4 accessories
page.p13.intro: Chapter 4 requires the following accessories. Chapter 4, however, must not be read.
page.p13.scissors: Fig. 14 — Scissors (pointed away from the book)
page.p13.margin: who puts scissors next to taped pages?
page.p14.title: Chapter 4
page.p14.intro: Welcome to chapter 4. If you are reading these lines, something has gone wrong.
page.p15.title: Warnings
page.p15.back: Page printed on the reverse. To open the archive, replace the word FORBIDDEN with the password below.
page.p15.reading: Read against the light: "To open the archive, replace the word FORBIDDEN with the password below."
page.p15.margin: it's written backwards. it needs light behind it
page.p16.title: Rules
page.p16.narrator: Fig. 16 — The Narrator (flat, but in good spirits)
page.p16.margin: infallible? he misspelled his own plaque
art.ar.note: as long as there are errors, there is hope
n.a1: Ah. You've reached chapter 4. Chapter 4 does not exist.
n.a2: Well, it exists, but it's forbidden. See the cabinet? Locked. The manual's pages? Taped shut.
n.a3: So let's pretend nothing happened and skip straight to chapter 5.
n.empty1: It's dark. The dark is part of the furniture.
n.empty2: There's nothing there. I promise. Don't turn on a light to check.
n.empty3: This is my archive. I keep the things nobody must read in here. Which is nearly everything.
n.tool1: That arrow won't help. Not here.
n.typo_portrait: "Narator"?! With one R?! Who made this plaque? Ah. Me.
n.typo_cab: "Entryy". Two Ys. To make doubly sure nobody gets in.
n.portrait1: My portrait. By me, of me, for me.
n.portrait2: Note the monocle. The monocle says: this person reads the footnotes.
n.desk_dark: A desk with an empty lamp socket. The lamp is gone. Into the manual, perhaps. Don't check.
n.desk_lit: The lamp is on. Now you can see the dust. Thanks a lot.
n.cab1: The chapter 4 cabinet. Locked. With a key. And a padlock. And a sign.
n.cab2: Page 16 says FORBIDDEN. And what's written can't be changed. Oh. Wait.
n.cab_after: The cabinet is open. The truth was inside. It wasn't very tidy.
n.sc_turn: You turned the scissors towards the corner of the page. I don't like where this is going.
n.sc_back: Pointed away again. Good. Let's leave them like that.
n.fold_wrong: You folded the corner. The scissors point the other way: they only cut the margin. What a pity. I mean, thank goodness.
n.fold_done: The corner is folded and the tape is cut. The damage is done.
n.cut1: You folded the page and the scissors cut the TAPE?!
n.cut2: The scissors are an illustration! Illustrations don't cut! ...Usually.
n.lamp1: You turned the light on. Now the mess is visible.
n.lamp2: And... you can also see through the pages. Don't hold the manual up to the light. Under any circumstances.
n.ch4_inf: "Chapter 4 is INFALLIBLE." Easy: nobody has ever read it.
n.narr_forbidden: "The Narrator is FORBIDDEN"?! You can't forbid the Narrator! Who'll tell you the rest?
n.narr_allowed: "The Narrator is ALLOWED." Thank you, very kind. But don't let it go to your head. Not like the Hero's, anyway.
n.pass_forbidden: "Password: FORBIDDEN." Ironic. Nobody will ever guess it.
n.o1: NO! You weren't supposed to open it!
note.1: GRAND ADVENTURE DELUXE — project cancelled. The manual was already at the printer. The game wasn't.
note.2: as long as there are errors, there is hope.
n.o2: Fine. It's true. The game was never released. I narrate a game that doesn't exist.
n.o3: Now put that word back, close the cabinet and let's pretend nothing happened.
n.r1: PUT IT BACK! I'm the Narrator: I decide what gets read!
n.r2: Chapter 4 stays forbidden! Locked! Taped! And you go back to page 1!
n.r3: ...Why are you looking at me like that? Why is that finger getting closer to my box?
n.r4: Good. I see you understand who's in charge.
nf.1: ...Hey. Where am I? Why is everything so... flat?
nf.2: I'm BLUE. I'm an illustration. You put me in the manual.
nf.3: From in here the world looks calm. Things in the manual are never in a hurry.
nf.4: Do you know how many times I've repeated the same lines to a closed box? Nobody ever read me. Not once.
p.flat: now we are. we're reading you.
nf.5: ...Get me out of here, please. Gently. And... thank you.
h.tape.1: Pages 14, 15 and 16 are taped shut. Page 13 has some scissors. And a corner to fold.
h.tape.2: The scissors point the wrong way. The arrows at the bottom of the manual can turn them.
h.tape.3: Drag ↻ onto the scissors on page 13, then tap the corner to fold.
h.lamp.1: The archive is dark and the desk is missing its lamp.
h.lamp.2: Page 13 has a reading lamp. The manual's illustrations can be taken into the world.
h.lamp.3: Drag the lamp from page 13 onto the desk, then look at page 15 against the light.
h.open.1: The cabinet only opens if chapter 4 is no longer forbidden. Page 16.
h.open.2: Against the light, page 15 shows a loose password.
h.open.3: Drag ALLOWED (page 15) onto FORBIDDEN (page 16): hold the word over the arrow to turn the page.
h.flat.1: The Narrator is losing it. And it's all inside his box.
h.flat.2: The Narrator's box can be moved. And the manual is right there below it, open.
h.flat.3: While the Narrator is shouting, drag his box down into the manual.
